title: Selling Plans Seller Terms — Fee Credits on Refunded and Cancelled Orders
content:
These are the general terms of **Selling Plans** on crediting seller fees back when an order is refunded or cancelled.

## Clauses in force

1. The per-order fee is credited too when the whole order has been refunded.
2. The below-standard surcharge is never credited.
3. Credits on one fee record, administration fees included, never exceed the fee billed.
4. Refunds funded by Northloop earn no credit because the seller never paid them.

## Retired clauses — no longer in force

> "When the seller refunds the item on an order within the refund credit window counted in calendar days from the order date, the variable final value fee of that order is credited in proportion to the refunded share of the fee basis, less a refund administration fee of the admin rate times that credit, capped at the admin fee cap" — no longer in force. Within it, the parts "the variable final value fee of that order is credited in proportion to the refunded share of the fee basis" and "less a refund administration fee of the admin rate times that credit, capped at the admin fee cap" are likewise no longer in force, together with the computation they carried (an administration fee of the admin rate times the credit, rounded to the nearest cent and capped at the admin fee cap, taken from the credit).
>
> "A refund on an order cancelled before shipment is credited in full" and "with no administration fee." — no longer in force.

These retired clauses are superseded by the current basis; the figures of the plan schedules themselves remain valid.

## What a fee credit record shows

A fee credit is booked against one fee record, once per credited fee record per credit reason (order refund, order cancellation or fee dispute upheld). The record shows the date credited, the order the credited fee was charged on (blank for fees not charged on an order), the fee record credited, the credit reason, the credit before any refund administration fee, the refund administration fee withheld, and the credit actually given — the credit before the fee less the fee withheld.

## The ceiling on credits for one fee record

**How much has already been credited.** The credits on a fee record are the credit given plus the refund administration fee withheld, added together over every fee credit record that names that fee record, over the record's whole life.

**Basis of the check.** Whether a fee record still has room for a credit is judged before the credit is booked, from the system's fee records — the credits already booked against that fee record, each identified by the fee record it names and its credit reason.

**Worked check (hypothetical figures).** A variable final value fee record billed USD 20.00 already carries one credit of USD 15.00 given with USD 3.00 withheld as an administration fee. Credits on the record total USD 18.00, so any further credit on that record, administration fee included, may not exceed USD 2.00.

## Points of judgement

- **Surcharge.** A below-standard surcharge record never receives a credit, whatever the refund.
- **Northloop-funded refunds.** A refund funded by Northloop earns no credit, because the seller never paid it.
- **Whole-order refunds.** The per-order fee is credited when the whole order has been refunded.
